key_findings: METTL3/YTHDC1-mediated m6A modification destabilizes RNF41 mRNA, impairing autophagy and ECM integrity in intervertebral disc degeneration.
METTL3 silencing AAV attenuated puncture-induced disc degeneration in rats, while RNF41 silencing exacerbated it.
